chunks: And Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Maḥmūd asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام:
about a rug and a mattress that are affected by urine—what should be done when it is thick and heavily padded
So he said: 'What appears on its surface should be washed.'

key_terms.الْبَوْلُ: urine, the impurity affecting the item
key_terms.فِي وَجْهِهِ: on its surface or outward face
key_terms.مَا ظَهَرَ: that which is visible or apparent

ai.seo_question: How should a thick rug or mattress be purified if urine reaches it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a thick, heavily padded rug or mattress that is affected by urine. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام instructs that the visible surface area be washed, indicating the practical method of purification in such cases.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.159 - Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmoud asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as)
about rug (al tanfasah) or mattress (al firash) that is affected by urine, especially if it is thick and heavily padded.
Imam (as) said: 'You should wash the surface that is visible.'.
